text: 锂离子、锂聚合物或铅酸电池；输出 2 路；{Initial battery capacity} 指定输入或参数、{Output battery voltage} 指定 Unfiltered 或 Filter、{Rated capacity at nominal temperature, BattChargeMax} 指定常量、{Open circuit voltage table data, Em} 指定一维查找表 1 -by、{State of charge breakpoints for open circuit voltage, SOCEmBp} 指定断点 1 -by、{Internal resistance table data, RInt} 指定二维查找表 N -by、{Battery temperature breakpoints, BattTempBp} 指定断点、{State of charge breakpoints for internal resistance, SOCRintBp} 指定断点、{Number of cells in series, Ns} 指定整数、{Number of cells in parallel, Np} 指定整数、{Initial battery capacity, BattCapInit} 指定容量、{Output battery voltage time constant, Tc} 指定滤波器时间常数、{Output battery voltage initial value, Vinit} 指定滤波器初始电压，按实例取值。
